capabilities.ui: pale.web: nine pages as views of gui/src/app.js with gui/index.html, served by the shared business Web Host (contribution/gui.json)

limitations: Pages are served by the shared business Web Host, which takes a registry and a sandbox or scenario profile; web-registry.json registers Crossway alone at its seed clock.
Three seeds: fixtures/minimal.json (dani, the manifest seed) and fixtures/seeds/marisol and fixtures/seeds/theo, loaded with env.load_seed using scripts/seed-bundle.cjs.
Notices are stored as Mail channel.email messages; examples/publish-to-mail.cjs publishes them through Messaging to Mail.
